$comment: Bitcoin Puzzle targets - the PUBLIC, funded challenge (privatekeys.pw/puzzles). Each puzzle #n has its private key uniformly random in [2^(n-1), 2^n). These addresses have NO exposed public key (never spent from), so Kangaroo cannot run and address brute force is the only method - which also means a solo rig is not structurally behind a Kangaroo farm on these. Addresses transcribed from privatekeys.pw. SOLO consented public challenge only; do not point tooling at any non-puzzle address.
